name: bmlt-search
author: BMLT Enabled
description: Cross-platform NA meeting search built on the BMLT, in SvelteKit + Capacitor.

scripts.#Device dev: Serve the bundle to a real device for HMR — see capacitor.config.ts
scripts.#Native sync: Copy the built web bundle into the native projects
scripts.#Icons: Regenerate every launcher icon and splash from assets/ — see assets/README.md
scripts.#Screenshots: Regenerate the App Store / Play screenshot sets from the simulator and emulator — see tools/screenshots/README.md
scripts.#Native open: Build, sync, then open the platform IDE
scripts.#Native run: Build, then compile and boot the app onto a simulator, emulator or device. `cap run` syncs on its own, so there is no sync step here. With no --target it prompts with a picker; targets:* prints that list non-interactively so an id can be pinned.
scripts.#Native run args: `&&` rather than run-s, so that `npm run sim:ios -- --target <id>` works: npm appends those args to the end of the script string, and only a chain ending in `cap` hands them over intact. Both run-s and a nested `npm run` parse them first and swallow the flag.
scripts.sim:ios: npm run build && cap run ios
scripts.sim:android: npm run build && cap run android
scripts.#Release: Build, sign and upload exactly as CI does — reads .env.release (op:// refs) via `op run`; see .env.release.example
scripts.all: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
